invariants.rationale: The result returned is exactly the sum as per the definition in the method.
Since padTop.get(this) and padBottom.get(this) could be zero or positive, result cannot be less than minHeight.get(actor).
If minHeight.get(actor), padTop.get(this), and padBottom.get(this) are all non-negative, which is typical for dimensions and paddings, result is also non-negative.
